b2-magyarfilm-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarians in Early Hollywood
b2-magyarfilm-01.scenario: At a film club in Budapest, a friend asks you about the Hungarian-born men who stood at the beginning of Hollywood, and what Adolph Zukor did.
b2-magyarfilm-01.prompt: Tell your friend what Zukor founded, and what was happening in American film production at the same time.
cues: Say what American film production was doing at that time
b2-magyarfilm-01.target: Zukor Adolf megalapította a Famous Players céget, miközben az amerikai filmgyártás Kaliforniába költözött.
b2-magyarfilm-01.english: Adolph Zukor founded the Famous Players company while American film production was moving to California.
b2-magyarfilm-01.canDo: I can describe, using miközben, how Hungarian-born producers and directors helped to shape early Hollywood.

b2-magyarfilm-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Camera in the Round-Up
b2-magyarfilm-02.scenario: After a screening of Jancsó Miklós's Szegénylegények in a Budapest cinema, a friend asks you what the camera does in the film.
b2-magyarfilm-02.prompt: Tell your friend what the camera does while the prisoners march.
cues: Say what the prisoners are doing
Say what the camera does at the same time, without cutting
b2-magyarfilm-02.target: Mialatt a rabok körbe-körbe meneteltek, a kamera vágás nélkül követte őket.
b2-magyarfilm-02.english: While the prisoners marched round and round, the camera followed them without cutting.
b2-magyarfilm-02.canDo: I can describe, using mialatt, what happens on screen in a film by Miklós Jancsó.

b2-magyarfilm-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Höfgen's Choice
b2-magyarfilm-03.scenario: At a university seminar on Szabó István's Mephisto, the teacher asks you what happens to the actor Höfgen when he feels the attraction of power.
b2-magyarfilm-03.prompt: Answer the teacher: say what Höfgen does the moment he feels the attraction of power.
cues: Say the moment he feels the attraction of power
Say what he gradually gives up
b2-magyarfilm-03.target: Amint Höfgen megérzi a hatalom vonzását, fokozatosan feladja az erkölcsi elveit.
b2-magyarfilm-03.english: As soon as Höfgen feels the attraction of power, he gradually gives up his moral principles.
b2-magyarfilm-03.canDo: I can say, using amint, what happens in Szabó István's Mephisto when the actor is offered power.

b2-magyarfilm-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Tarr's Time
b2-magyarfilm-04.scenario: In a cinema café after a screening of a Béla Tarr film, a friend asks you why the film feels so different from other films.
b2-magyarfilm-04.prompt: Tell your friend what happens to the viewer the moment the camera starts moving along the muddy street.
cues: Say the moment the camera starts moving
Say what the viewer leaves behind
b2-magyarfilm-04.target: Mihelyt a kamera elindul a sáros utcán, a néző kilép a hétköznapi időérzékelésből.
b2-magyarfilm-04.english: The moment the camera starts moving along the muddy street, the viewer steps out of everyday time.
b2-magyarfilm-04.canDo: I can say, using mihelyt, what happens the moment a film by Márta Mészáros or Béla Tarr begins.

b2-magyarfilm-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Camera on Saul's Face
b2-magyarfilm-05.scenario: At a film festival talk in Budapest, a guest asks you what the critics noticed in Nemes Jeles László's Saul fia.
b2-magyarfilm-05.prompt: Tell the guest what the film captures each time the camera focuses on Saul's gaze.
cues: Say what the film captures instead of destruction
b2-magyarfilm-05.target: Valahányszor a kamera Saul tekintetére fókuszál, a film az emberi méltóságot ragadja meg.
b2-magyarfilm-05.english: Whenever the camera focuses on Saul's gaze, the film captures human dignity.
b2-magyarfilm-05.canDo: I can describe, using valahányszor, what happens each time in Saul fia and in Testről és lélekről.

b2-magyarfilm-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarian Oscars
b2-magyarfilm-consolidation.scenario: A friend visiting Budapest asks you in a café which Hungarian films won the Oscar for best foreign language film.
b2-magyarfilm-consolidation.prompt: Tell your friend about the two films, and say what happened as soon as the first one won.
cues: Name the film of 1982 and what it brought the country
Name the later film and when it won
b2-magyarfilm-consolidation.target: Amint a Mephisto 1982-ben elnyerte az Oscar-díjat, Magyarország megkapta az első ilyen díját; a Saul fia 2016-ban megismételte ezt a sikert.
b2-magyarfilm-consolidation.english: As soon as Mephisto won the Oscar in 1982, Hungary received its first such award; Saul fia repeated this success in 2016.
b2-magyarfilm-consolidation.canDo: I can outline Hungarian film history from the Hollywood pioneers to Jancsó, Szabó, Tarr and Nemes Jeles.
